messages:
jordan (sec-eng): Heads up — noticed a production user got the wrong org role after JIT SAML provisioning. They should be 'developer' but were provisioned as 'org-admin'.
leah (idp): ugh, that sounds bad. any quick reproduction or logs?
jordan (sec-eng): reproducer from their SAML assertion attached in the trace:
```
Assertion Attributes: {
  email: 'alice+featureX@acme.com',
  roles: ['org-admin','developer'],
  role_priority: 'roles_ordered'
}
```
jordan (sec-eng): note the plus-addressing in email and multiple roles present. our code picks the first role returned by Okta.
leah (idp): we shipped an attribute normalization change last night to strip tags on emails but it only applied to SCIM user records, not SAML assertions. oops.
maria (prod-sre): impact? how many users? any active sessions with escalated perms?
jordan (sec-eng): so far just 3 users in the tenant. one performed a read-only dashboard action; no write calls observed. audit logs show role assigned at provisioning time.
alex (platform): mitigation: we can flip the JIT fallback to 'require_group_membership' flag for that tenant to stop auto-assigning roles, or force role-filtering to only allow whitelisted roles. Which is quicker?
leah (idp): quick is flip JIT off for org. I can do that via admin console. Longer fix is to change role precedence logic: prefer role in `groups` claim then fallback to `roles` list, and always normalize emails by lowercasing and stripping +tags before matching.
jordan (sec-eng): agree. also need to ensure audit events include raw SAML assertion for triage (we only log parsed attrs currently). add a short-term trace copy to S3? idp-bot: deploy scheduled: idp-service/normalize-email v2 -> canary starting in 5m.
maria (prod-sre): before we do anything, let's create a scoped incident: severity P2, owners @leah @jordan, action items: revert JIT for tenant, rotate API keys if any privileged actions, record audit events.
jordan (sec-eng): created incident 2026-03-20-01 in the incident tracker and attached the assertion snippet. linking here.
leah (idp): done — JIT provisioning disabled for tenant acme-01 and change propagated. confirming with logs...
leah (idp): log: "provisioning.blocked tenant=acme-01 user=alice+featureX@acme.com reason=jit_disabled"
alex (platform): pushed a hotfix to role-selection code to prefer explicit `groups` claim; will roll to canary. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/idp/pull/482
jordan (sec-eng): thumbs — after canary if all good, schedule full rollout and follow-up audit to list affected users and remap roles where necessary. also need a postmortem to update docs: recommended SAML attribute formats and JIT safety checks.
maria (prod-sre): after-action checklist: 1) confirm no privileged writes, 2) remap users, 3) add e2e test for plus-addressed emails, 4) add assertion raw capture to secure audit.
leah (idp): will add unit + integration tests and a quick eval to ensure normalization covers SAML and SCIM.
jordan (sec-eng): ETA for full fix and remap?
aleph (typo on purpose):
leah (idp): ETA ~6h to finish canary + 2h observation, then full rollout. remap script should be ~1h after rollout.
jordan (sec-eng): thanks all. I'm adding a note to the compliance log to record key rotation and audit retention extension for this tenant.
idp-bot: incident P2 acknowledged and tracked as INC-2026-0319.
leah (idp): follow-up: adding defensive check: if roles list contains any role outside the allowed whitelist, ignore them and log for manual review. will push in next patch.
jordan (sec-eng): perfect. please ping when done and I'll close the incident after verification.
leah (idp): will do. :thumbsup:
